questions.question:
주어진 대화의 흐름에 맞도록 (A)~(E)를 순서대로 배열한 것은?

(A) Yes. How about you?
(B) Really? So you can play the piano?
(C) Well, I've never learned how to play.
(D) Me, too. I also enjoy playing the piano.
(E) I love listening to piano music.
(F) I'm going to buy this CD.
It's fun. I hope you'll have a chance to learn.
questions.explanation: 대화의 흐름: (F) 나는 이 CD를 사려고 한다 → (E) 피아노 음악 듣기를 좋아한다 → (D) 나도 피아노 연주를 즐긴다 → (B) 피아노를 연주할 수 있냐? → (C) 배운 적이 없다 → (A) 너는?

questions.question:
글의 흐름으로 볼 때 (A)~(E) 중 가장 자연스럽지 않은 것은?

Are you working towards your dream? Here's some advice to help you.
First, follow your heart. (A)Think about what you like to do and what makes you happy.
Second, work hard. (B)Pursuing a dream is not easy. (C)I became a photographer through hard work.
Third, be bold. (D)You need courage to change your life. I was afraid but I took a chance.
(E)Sometimes, people get frustrated when they can't seize the opportunities they've always wanted. I truly hope you can find a dream, pursue it, and live it!
questions.explanation: (E)는 "때때로 사람들이 원하던 기회를 잡을 수 없을 때 좌절감을 느낀다"는 내용으로 전체 조언의 흐름과 맞지 않으며, 갑자기 부정적인 내용이 삽입되어 자연스럽지 않습니다.

questions.question:
다음 글에서 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 것은?

My dream is to become a famous fashion designer. There are many things to do to realize my dream. First, ⓐI'll go to design school and study fashion design. ⓑThen, after I graduate, I'll work at a fashion company. ⓒWhen I'm 30, I'll start my own brand. ⓓLaunching a new brand will be delayed for a while. ⓔI hope my dream will come true.
questions.explanation: ⓓ "새로운 브랜드 출시가 한동안 지연될 것이다"는 꿈을 이루려는 긍정적인 계획의 흐름과 맞지 않습니다. 다른 문장들은 꿈을 실현하기 위한 단계적 계획을 제시하는데, ⓓ만 이를 방해하는 부정적인 내용입니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Changing a career is not easy. _____(가)_____, there are many famous people who chose to make major career changes and succeeded. Here are some examples.

Example 1
John Glenn is best known (A) [as / to] an astronaut. But at 53 years old, he became a U.S. senator in Ohio, a role he held for 24 years.

Example 2
Terry Crews is a comedian who (B) [is / are] famous for popular TV shows. _____(가)_____, in the mid-90s, he was a defensive player for various American football teams.

Example 3
Vera Wang was a figure skater and a journalist before entering the fashion industry at age 40. Today she's one of the world's most famous women's fashion (C) [designer / designers].

(A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절하게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) "best known as" - '~으로 알려져 있다' (B) "a comedian who are" → "a comedian who is" (단수) (C) "women's fashion designers" - 여러 명의 여성 패션 디자이너 중 한 명이므로 복수형이 아닌 단수형이 맞습니다. 정답은 (A) as (B) are (C) designers입니다.

questions.explanation: 첫 번째 (가): "경력 변경은 쉽지 않다. 그러나 성공한 많은 유명인들이 있다" - 대조 표현 필요. 두 번째 (가): "코미디언으로 유명하다. 그러나 90년대 중반에는 미식축구 선수였다" - 대조 표현 필요. "However"가 두 곳에 모두 적절합니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
After I came back, ⓐI entered a photo contest with the pictures I took them in Iceland.
Surprisingly, I won first prize, and ⓑthis gave me a chance to think about my life. ⓒI realized that taking pictures made me happy. Suddenly, I wanted to become a good photographer, So I started to learn more about photography. After years of trial and error, I got better, and I began to do some part-time work as a photographer.
Then one day, I made a bold decision. ⓓI quit my job and decided to take pictures for a living.
ⓔI wasn't sure if I could succeed or not, but I decided to try. I really wanted to do something that made me happy. Now, I'm a professional photographer, and I'm happy.

밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 올바르지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ "the pictures I took them in Iceland" - 중복입니다. "them"을 제거하거나 "the pictures (that) I took in Iceland" 형태로 수정되어야 합니다. 올바른 형태는 "the pictures I took in Iceland"입니다.

Pursuing dreams ⓒare not easy. I became a photographer through hard work. Third, be bold. You need courage to make decisions ⓓwhat will change your life. I was afraid but I took a chance. 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 적절한 것은?

 I'm a(n) ________. I usually take pictures of nature.
 My ________ in college was Korean history.
 If you're bold, it means that you have ________ to do something.

questions.explanation: ① abroad (해외에서) - "I made a decision to live abroad from next month" (해외에서 살기로 결정했다) - 문맥에 맞지만, 이 문장에서 다른 단어들과 달리 이 선택지가 위치할 수 없습니다. 재평가하면 "photographer"(사진작가), "major"(전공), "pursue"(추구하다), "chance"(기회)는 모두 각 문장에 들어갈 수 있습니다. 하지만 "abroad"는 일반적으로 첫 번째 문장에 들어갈 수 없습니다.

Hello, everyone. My name is David Parker, and I'm a photographer. Today, I'm going to tell you how I found my dream and realized ⓐit. I hope my story can inspire you.

When I had to decide on a major in college, I chose engineering. I didn't really like ⓒit, but being an engineer looked OK. After college, I got a job at an engineering company. ⓓIt was a stable job, but I didn't know whether I enjoyed ⓔit.

questions.explanation: G가 책을 읽으라고 제안 → (ⓓ) 이미 읽었다고 답함 → (ⓑ) 정말? 영화도 봤니? → (ⓐ) 아니 안 봤어 → (ⓒ) 영화가 더 좋은데 봐봐 의 순서가 논리적이다.

options: The woman is the writer of the book about training all animals.
They are planning to do some volunteer work together.
The woman wants to become an animal doctor.
The boy is making a lot of TV shows about animals.
The boy is working hard to achieve his goal.
questions.question:
[지문]
B: I really liked your book about training dogs.
W: Thank you. Do you like dogs?
B: Yes, I do. I love all kinds of animals.
W: Have you ever thought of becoming an animal doctor?
B: Yes, have I really want to become an animal doctor.
W: What are you doing to achieve your goal?
B: I'm doing volunteer work at the local animal house.
W: That's good. What else are you doing?
B: I'm also watching a lot of TV shows about animals.
W: You're doing great! I hope you become a good animal doctor someday.
B: Thank you.
(B: boy W: woman)

대화를 읽고 내용과 일치하는 것은?
questions.explanation: 소년이 자신의 목표(동물 의사가 되기)를 달성하기 위해 동물 보호소에서 자원봉사를 하고, 동물에 관한 TV 프로그램을 많이 보고 있다는 내용에서 그가 목표를 달성하기 위해 열심히 일하고 있음을 알 수 있다.

questions.question:
[지문]
(가) My dream is to become a famous fashion designer. (나) First go to design school and study fashion design. (다) Then, after I graduate, I'll work at a fashion company. (라) When I'm 30. I'll start my own brand. When I'm 35, I'll hold my first fashion show. (마) I hope my dream will come true.

<보기>
There are many things to do to realize my dream.

다음 글의 흐름으로 볼 때, <보기>의 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?
questions.explanation: 꿈을 소개한 후((가)), '많은 것들을 할 필요가 있다'는 보기 문장이 오고, 그 다음에 구체적인 계획들((나), (다), (라))이 이어지는 것이 자연스럽다.
